title: Reasoning model returns empty text with status incomplete while you are still billed
symptoms: Usage shows many output tokens but no visible answer
cause: max_output_tokens caps reasoning tokens and visible tokens together, so a small cap can be spent entirely on reasoning before any answer is written. Those reasoning tokens are billed as output.
fix: Leave a large budget, OpenAI suggests at least 25000 tokens when starting out, and check status before reading the text.
affected: OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions with reasoning models, checked October 2026
